bib.title: S2ORC: The Semantic Scholar Open Research Corpus
bib.venue: Proceedings of the 58th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (ACL), pages 4969-4983

question: Can PDF and LaTeX parses of academic papers be aggregated into one large, structured, citation-linked, openly available text corpus useful for text mining and language model pretraining?
hypothesis: A BERT-Base pretrained on S2ORC full text, despite a more diverse domain mix, performs comparably to SciBERT on scientific NLP tasks.
contributions: S2ORC: 81.1M English academic papers with metadata, abstracts and resolved bibliographic links, plus structured full text for 8.1M open-access PDFs and 1.5M LaTeX parses
Pipeline for metadata aggregation, PDF/LaTeX parsing, clustering and bibliography linking
Evaluation of data quality and release of S2ORC-SciBERT as a baseline

method.summary: Papers from the Semantic Scholar corpus (~200M clusters) are filtered, PDFs parsed with ScienceParse and GROBID, arXiv LaTeX parsed to XML, canonical metadata selected, clusters filtered, and bibliography entries linked by character 3-gram title similarity. A BERT-Base is pretrained on the cleaned PDF-parsed body text (16.4B tokens) to show the corpus works for LM pretraining.
method.task: corpus construction (academic text) and BERT-Base pretraining

datasets.name: S2ORC
datasets.size: 81.1M papers; 8.1M GROBID full text; 1.5M LaTeX full text; 380.5M citation links
datasets.source: Semantic Scholar literature corpus; open access = arXiv, ACL Anthology, PubMed Central (OA) or Unpaywall open-access DOI (2019-04-19 dump)
datasets.preprocessing: Filters: no title, no authors, <100 chars of text, non-English (cld2, threshold 0.9). PDF filters: PyPDF2 error, >50 pages, width>height, pdfalto error.

datasets.name: S2ORC pretraining corpus (S2ORC-SciBERT)
datasets.preprocessing: Excludes figure captions, table text and captions, headers, footers, footnotes; tokenized and sentencized with scispaCy; heuristic filters remove ill-formed paragraphs (e.g. too many symbols). Biomedical 42.7%, CS 7.2% of corpus.

datasets.name: SciBERT evaluation suite (Beltagy et al. 2019): BC5CDR, JNLPBA, NCBI-disease, EBM-NLP, GENIA, ChemProt, SciERC, ACL-ARC, SciCite, PaperField
datasets.split: dev for hyperparameter selection, test reported

models.name: S2ORC-SciBERT
models.vocab: 31k (built from 15% of the S2ORC pretraining corpus)

other.pretraining_corpus: 82% biomedical, 18% CS; roughly 5x smaller than S2ORC pretraining corpus

training.objective: inferred: original BERT pretraining objective (original BERT code, defaults); fine-tuning minimises cross entropy
training.lr: fine-tune max LR grid 1e-5, 2e-5, 3e-5, 5e-5; pretraining LR not stated
training.epochs: fine-tune 1 to 4 epochs, chosen on dev

other.hyperparameter_search: equal-sized grid to Beltagy et al. 2019; best epochs x LR per task by dev set
other.code: original BERT code and SciBERT code for fine-tuning

parameters.title_similarity: S_title = 2JC/(J+C), char 3-grams, Jaccard J and containment C

other.citation_embedding_demo: word2vec skip-gram on citation contexts with inline citation spans replaced by paper ids (following Berger et al. 2016); 20k papers in six AI arXiv categories; t-SNE; hyperparameters not given

metrics.name: title/author accuracy
metrics.definition: fraction of sampled clusters or linked bib entries whose canonical title/authors match the PDF or bib entry

baselines: SciBERT (reported numbers from Beltagy et al. 2019)
eval.protocol: Quality: 500 sampled clusters with PDFs for metadata; 500 GROBID and 100 LaTeX bib links (one entry per paper); 200 sampled papers for GROBID citation/bib F1. Downstream: mean +- std of 5 seeds, dev-selected hyperparameters, test reported; SciBERT reports no std or run count.

limits: Only SciBERT-suite downstream tasks; results are mixed (wins on most, loses ACL-ARC and SciCite), 'comparable' not better
No ablation of corpus size, domain mix or cleaning; pretraining LR, batch size, steps, seq length not stated
SciBERT reports no std or runs, so differences are not tested for significance
Only 35.6% of papers have PDFs and 10.0% have full text; linking depends on titles and fails for LaTeX physics bibliographies (6.8 vs 19.3 linked entries)
Paper-cluster canonical document may mismatch the version cited (App. C)
Corpus has since been superseded by later S2ORC releases (not covered in the paper)
